name: sherpa-lm
description: Sherpa LM — on-demand last-mile delivery platform (Bogotá)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,driver -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sherpa/api" "npm run dev -w @sherpa/admin" "npm run dev -w @sherpa/driver"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sherpa/shared && npm run build -w @sherpa/api && npm run build -w @sherpa/admin && npm run build -w @sherpa/driver
